description: Step 1 of starting (Watch), stopping (Unwatch) or sharing (Bind) a watch. Returns EIP-712 `typedData` for the manager's OWNER (ownerOf(1) — `signer` names them) to sign with their own wallet, valid 10 minutes, and `next`: the tool to pass {chainId, message, signature} to — watch_subscribe, watch_cancel or watch_bind. This server signs nothing and an agent's own key is not the owner's unless it owns the manager.

kind.description: Watch = start or update watching (may cost); Unwatch = stop; Bind = share which positions follow a strategy (free)

mode.description: Watch only. owner (default) — the Watcher tells the owner when to act; agent — the owner's agent acts and the Watcher audits it

positions.description: Position salts (get_position_history). Watch: 1–32; Bind: 0–32 (none forgets the binding); Unwatch: none

name: watch_prepare
title: Watcher: typed data for the owner to sign
